🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 26, 2026

Sun, in Scorpio, holds an opposition to Moon, exalted in Taurus. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Libra, Venus quotes your worth back at you. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Fixed earth: what is kept and who keeps it merge. Venus has not been in Scorpio for four weeks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Mars sextiles you from Leo: a door left ajar. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. Since Mercury crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, honoured in Taurus. From Scorpio, Sun agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. Moon in Taurus stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed fire pays to hold on. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Sun in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. Two weeks ago Mercury was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Leo, Mars offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Taurus sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fixed water: the grip is the expense. Seven days ago none of this was in place.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. After three weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Sun in Scorpio leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Sun squares you from Scorpio, and something has to give way. Air holds on, and the holding is billed. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun trines you from Scorpio, and the ease asks its own attention. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.
